name: Shikanoin Heizou
mistakes: Using his Skill with no Declension stacks: Swirls and Hold charging build them.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Fudou Style Martial Arts
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 fisticuffs empowered by a mighty wind, dealing Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and performs a sweeping kick that deals Anemo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Calling upon the surging wind, Heizou plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in his path. Deals AoE Anemo DMG upon impact with the ground.
abilities.simple: Up to 5 Anemo punches, an Anemo Charged Attack and a plunge.

abilities.name: Heartstopper Strike
abilities.canon:
Tap
Wields the swift winds to launch a Heartstopper Strike that deals Anemo DMG.

Hold
Charges energy to unleash an even stronger blow. He will obtain the Declension effect while charging, which will increase the power of the Heartstopper Strike. When the skill button is released or the skill finishes charging, he will strike forward, dealing Anemo DMG.

Declension
Increases the power of the next Heartstopper Strike. Max 4 stacks.
When you possess 4 Declension stacks, the Conviction effect will be produced, which will cause the next Heartstopper Strike to be even stronger and have a larger AoE.
abilities.simple: Tap: a Heartstopper Strike with Anemo. Hold: charge it up for a stronger blow, gaining Declension stacks.

abilities.name: Windmuster Kick
abilities.canon:
Leaps into the air and uses the Fudou Style Vacuum Slugger and kicks his opponent. The Vacuum Slugger will explode upon hit and create an Arresting Windtunnel that pulls in nearby objects and opponents, dealing AoE Anemo DMG.
When Vacuum Slugger hits opponents affected by Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, these opponents will be afflicted with Windmuster Iris. This Windmuster Iris will explode after a moment and dissipate, dealing AoE DMG of the corresponding aforementioned elemental type.
Vacuum Slugger can afflict a maximum of 4 opponents with the Windmuster Iris. A single opponent cannot be under the effect of Windmuster Irises of different elements at the same time.
abilities.simple: A kick that creates an Arresting Windtunnel, pulling enemies in with Anemo damage.

abilities.name: Paradoxical Practice
abilities.canon: When Shikanoin Heizou activates a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction while on the field, he will gain 1 Declension stack for Heartstopper Strike. This effect can be triggered once every 0.1s.
abilities.simple: Triggering Swirl or Stellar Swirl on the field gives a Declension stack.

abilities.name: Penetrative Reasoning
abilities.canon: After Shikanoin Heizou's Heartstopper Strike hits an opponent, increases all party members' (excluding Shikanoin Heizou) Elemental Mastery by 80 for 10s.
abilities.simple: When his Heartstopper Strike hits, the rest of the party gains Elemental Mastery.

abilities.name: Pre-Existing Guilt
abilities.canon:
Decreases sprinting Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.
abilities.simple: Your party uses 20% less Stamina when sprinting. An exploration perk.

abilities.name: Named Juvenile Casebook
abilities.canon: For 5s after Shikanoin Heizou takes the field, his Normal Attack SPD is increased by 15%. He also gains 1 Declension stack for Heartstopper Strike. This effect can be triggered once every 10s.
abilities.simple: For 5s after he takes the field, his Normal Attack speed rises by 15%, and he gains a Declension stack.

abilities.name: Investigative Collection
abilities.canon: The pull effect of the Arresting Windtunnel created by Windmuster Kick is enhanced, and its duration is increased to 1s.
abilities.simple: The Windtunnel pulls harder and lasts 1s.

abilities.name: Esoteric Puzzle Book
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Heartstopper Strike by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Heartstopper Strike by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Tome of Lies
abilities.canon:
The first Windmuster Iris explosion in each Windmuster Kick will regenerate 9 Elemental Energy for Shikanoin Heizou. Every subsequent explosion in that Windmuster Kick will each regenerate an additional 1.5 Energy for Heizou.
One Windmuster Kick can regenerate a total of 13.5 Energy for Heizou in this manner.
abilities.simple: His Burst’s first explosion restores 9 Energy.

abilities.name: Secret Archive
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Windmuster Kick by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Windmuster Kick by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Curious Casefiles
abilities.canon: Each Declension stack will increase the CRIT Rate of the Heartstopper Strike unleashed by 4%. When Heizou possesses Conviction, this Heartstopper Strike's CRIT DMG is increased by 32%.
abilities.simple: Each Declension stack adds 4% CRIT Rate to Heartstopper Strike.

fundamentals.simple: Heizou builds Declension stacks, then his Skill’s Heartstopper Strike hits harder and buffs the party’s Elemental Mastery.
